title: C23 Real OAuth (Auth.js) — additive variant

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: An ADDITIVE Auth.js setup lives entirely in this challenge's own route group with its own config (JWT session, no database); it does NOT edit the frozen lib/auth and does NOT edit proxy.ts (independence: it is a parallel auth variant, not a replacement).

The challenge offers a no-setup Credentials-provider fallback alongside at least one real OAuth provider, so the lab runs without external secrets while still demonstrating the real OAuth path; .env.example documents the OAuth provider variables.
Signing in establishes an Auth.js JWT session and a protected page is gated by that session (unauthenticated access is blocked/redirected); sign-out clears it.
NOTES.md explains the OAuth flow, the callback handling, and the CSRF state parameter, and contrasts this Auth.js model with the self-contained C01 session foundation.
The c23 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
